messages:
tess_newhire: Hey all — first week onboarding benefits/payroll q's. Started 2026-12-20. 1) I enrolled in medical but need coverage for a dentist appt on 2027-01-10 — any chance it will be active? 2) I paid $120 for an external webcam for remote meetings before company gear arrived  what's the exact expense flow? 3) Do floating holidays get prorated and are they visible in Rippling immediately? 4) My state tax residency changed recently  do I need to submit any paper forms?

sophie (People Ops): Welcome Tess! :wave: Quick answers: 1) Coverage effective date = first of month after 30 days from start, so with 12/20 start that's 2027-02-01 under standard rules. If you need proof for the dentist sooner, we can provide a benefits verification letter for that appt. 2) Expense: use Ramp (category "Onboarding - Home Office") or the expense Google Form if you don't have Ramp. 3) Floating holidays are prorated and should appear in Rippling within one pay cycle; if not, DM me. 4) Update state withholding in Rippling and upload any state-specific W-4; payroll will confirm.

tess_newhire: thanks  can i get the wording for the benefits verification letter? dentist needs a reference code sometimes.

sophie (People Ops): We usually send a PDF letter that states: "Employee: Tess [LastName], Start Date: 2026-12-20, Anticipated Coverage Effective Date: 2027-02-01; Insurance Carrier: [CarrierName]; Member ID: Pending Enrollment Processing." Email benefits@redwood.com with the appt date and provider and we'll generate it same day.

alec_finance: For the webcam reimbursement, attach receipt in Ramp and use this example note: 

```
Expense: Webcam purchase
Amount: $120.00
Date: 2026-12-21
Receipt: webcam_receipt.jpg
Category: Onboarding - Home Office
Notes: Purchased prior to company equipment delivery
```

alec_finance: If you don't have Ramp access, use https://forms.gle/expense-redwood and cc finance@redwood.com. Approval ~3 business days, payout on next payroll unless urgent-offcycle requested.

hr-bot: Reminder: New hire benefits enrollment due by 2027-01-03. Complete elections in Rippling to avoid default plan assignment.

tess_newhire: floating holidays  do those accumulate or are they a one-off balance? Also, if i take one before it's visible, will it still count?

sophie (People Ops): Floating holidays are a fixed annual allowance and are prorated by hire date. They appear as a balance in Rippling; if you request one before it shows up, we can approve and manually adjust the balance so it doesn't block your PTO request. Just DM me with dates.

tess_newhire: state tax  moved from CA to WA recently. WA has no income tax  do i need to do anything other than update Rippling?

mike_payroll: Update your address and state withholding in Rippling. If you moved states after your offer, upload proof of residency (utility/lease) to Rippling to avoid retro withholding. For WA there's no state payroll tax, but we need correct home state to prevent incorrect withholdings. If you already owe CA withholding from prior employer, that's separate.

tess_newhire: one small ask  will the webcam reimbursement show on my paystub line-item? Trying to keep my records tidy for taxes.

alec_finance: Reimbursements paid via payroll show as taxable or non-taxable per policy. On your paystub it will appear as a reimbursement line and the memo will include the expense category. If it's relocation or a non-taxable onboarding item it will be marked accordingly; finance can provide the payment memo if you need it for records.

sophie (People Ops): If you'd like, include the expense ID or Ramp link in your direct message and I can confirm how it'll show on the stub. Welcome again! :tada:
